title: 技術者と持続可能社会
subtitle: Engineer and Sustainable Society
courseType: Student and Study Skills Courses ProgramCharacter Building CoursesCharacter Building
educationalGoal: Maintaining an interest in social trends, understanding market conditions and customer needs, and societal expectations of companies operating within society, students will appreciate quality, cost, delivery, and safety as essential engineering skills and be able to research and analyze corporate activities using a scientific approach. Students will also understand innovation and connect it to their own career design to help realize a sustainable society.
advice:
The students considered their future career direction in the "Basic Style for Study" in the first year. Based on this, in this course, students will learn the following items needed to do a good job at a company.

(1) Understand the trends of sustainable society such as SDGs, the role of companies, and the responsibilities and rewards of engineers working there.
(2) Learn basic management knowledge and matters related to the work of engineers, such as R & D and production processes.
(3) Understand that there is a wide variety of industries in society, and engineers are active in various occupations in a wide range of fields.
(4) Deepen understanding of the work of engineers by exchanging opinions on items investigated by themselves through group discussions and presentations.
(5) Learn examples of innovation to play an active role in a developing society.

              Maintaining an interest in social trends, understanding market conditions and customer needs, and societal expectations of companies operating within society, students will appreciate quality, cost, delivery, and safety as essential engineering skills and be able to research and analyze corporate activities using a scientific approach. Students will also understand innovation and connect it to their own career design to help realize a sustainable society.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The students considered their future career direction in the "Basic Style for Study" in the first year. Based on this, in this course, students will learn the following items needed to do a good job at a company.

(1) Understand the trends of sustainable society such as SDGs, the role of companies, and the responsibilities and rewards of engineers working there.
(2) Learn basic management knowledge and matters related to the work of engineers, such as R & D and production processes.
(3) Understand that there is a wide variety of industries in society, and engineers are active in various occupations in a wide range of fields.
(4) Deepen understanding of the work of engineers by exchanging opinions on items investigated by themselves through group discussions and presentations.
(5) Learn examples of innovation to play an active role in a developing society.
